#469 · Ogre Darner Pokémon

Yanmega

Bug Flying

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Yanmega is a Bug/Flying-type Ogre Darner Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 51.5 kg. It evolves from Yanma. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (116), with a base stat total of 515.
